messages.body_plain:
Hi, I am new to MaAslin. When I look at the Galaxy tutorial, it says "The microbial measurements are expected to be normalized before using MaAsLin and so are proportional data ranging from 0 to 1.0". Does it mean that each microbial count is normalized (divided) by the sample total? If so, all the microbial percentages in a sample should add to 1, correct?

However, when I look at the sample file located at: https://bytebucket.org/biobakery/maaslin/wiki/maaslin_demo_pcl.txt. that is not the case.

So what kind of normalization do you recommend for MaAslin?

thanks,
John
